user.description: Pick an ESPHome device running the MusicSpot firmware. It will control this Spotify account.

data_description.device_id: The ESPHome device running MusicSpot. It must be online.
data_description.art_base_url: How the panel reaches Home Assistant for album art, e.g. http://192.168.1.2:8123. Plain HTTP on your LAN is fastest. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's internal URL.
data_description.default_device: Spotify device name to start playback on when nothing is active, e.g. Living room. Optional.
